products.name: Rosehip & Jojoba Radiant Face Oil
products.description: A restorative, fast-absorbing botanical oil formulated with organic cold-pressed rosehip seed and wild-grown golden jojoba. Packed with antioxidants, essential fatty acids, and Vitamin C to restore youthful vibrancy and calm dry or sensitive skin.
products.ingredients: Organic Rosa Canina (Rosehip) Seed Oil, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Squalane, Tocopherol (Vitamin E), Frankincense Essential Oil.
benefits: Deeply hydrates without clogging pores
Brightens uneven tone and softens fine lines
Soothes redness and strengthens natural lipid barrier

products.name: Wild Turmeric & Raw Honey Clarifying Cleanser
products.description: Gently melts away impurities, pollutants, and makeup while nourishing the microbiome. Infused with wild-harvested golden turmeric root and raw forest honey for a dewy, glowing finish.
products.ingredients: Aqua, Wild Kasturi Turmeric Extract, Raw Forest Honey, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Decyl Glucoside, Vegetable Glycerin, Chamomile Extract.
benefits: Purifies skin without stripping natural moisture
Naturally antibacterial turmeric calms breakouts
Leaves skin supple, soft, and luminous

products.name: Cold-Pressed Moroccan Argan & Rosemary Hair Serum
products.description: A nourishing elixir of pure virgin Moroccan argan kernel oil and steam-distilled rosemary leaf essential oil. Promotes hair follicle vitality, reduces breakage, and restores brilliant luster.
products.ingredients: 100% Pure Argania Spinosa (Argan) Kernel Oil, Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Leaf Oil, Cedarwood Essential Oil, Sweet Almond Oil.
benefits: Stimulates scalp micro-circulation for thicker hair
Tames frizz and flyaways with non-greasy silkiness
Protects against environmental and heat stress

products.name: High-Altitude French Lavender Calming Essential Oil
products.description: Steam-distilled from organic Lavandula angustifolia grown in high-altitude Provence meadows. Delivers a peaceful floral aroma that relieves stress, balances mood, and enhances tranquil sleep.
products.ingredients: 100% Pure Lavandula Angustifolia (High-Altitude Lavender) Essential Oil.
benefits: Promotes deep relaxation and restorative sleep
Can be diffused or blended into carrier oils
Known for natural skin-soothing qualities

products.name: Handcrafted Activated Charcoal & Tea Tree Bar
products.description: Cold-process artisan soap cure-aged for 6 weeks. Bamboo activated charcoal detoxifies pore buildup while Australian tea tree and eucalyptus essential oils leave skin refreshingly clean.
products.ingredients: Saponified Oils of Olive, Coconut, and Sustainable Palm, Bamboo Activated Charcoal, Tea Tree Oil, Eucalyptus Leaf Oil, Shea Butter.
benefits: Draws out deep-seated impurities and excess sebum
Gentle rich lather that doesn't dehydrate the skin
100% biodegradable and zero plastic packaging

products.name: Organic Chamomile & Ashwagandha Restorative Tea
products.description: A calming herbal infusion blending whole Egyptian chamomile blossoms with adaptogenic wild ashwagandha root, spearmint, and organic licorice. Designed to unwind nervous tension.
products.ingredients: Organic Whole Chamomile Flowers, Withania Somnifera (Ashwagandha) Root, Spearmint Leaves, Licorice Root, Cardamom Pods.
benefits: Supports adaptogenic stress resilience and evening wind-down
Caffeine-free soothing botanical tea
Warm, naturally sweet floral tasting notes

products.name: Raw Whipped Shea & Kokum Botanical Body Butter
products.description: Decadently whipped unrefined Ghanaian shea butter and Indian kokum butter infused with sweet almond and vanilla bean oil. Melts into contact to deeply condition very dry patches.
products.ingredients: Unrefined Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Garcinia Indica (Kokum) Butter, Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis (Sweet Almond) Oil, Vanilla Planifolia Oleoresin.
benefits: 24-hour long-lasting skin moisture replenishment
Smooths rough elbows, knees, and dry heels
Subtle natural gourmand scent from pure vanilla bean

products.name: Neem & Holy Basil (Tulsi) Clarifying Face Gel
products.description: Lightweight, cooling oil-free gel crafted with active fresh aloe vera fillet, bio-fermented neem leaf extract, and organic holy basil (Tulsi) for clear, balanced skin.
products.ingredients: Pure Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Azadirachta Indica (Neem) Leaf Extract, Ocimum Sanctum (Tulsi) Extract, Niacinamide, Sodium Hyaluronate.
benefits: Instantly cools inflammation and reduces shine
Lightweight hydration perfect for warm weather
Restores crystal clarity to blemish-prone complexions
